title: Best robot lawnmower deal: Save over $600 on the Ecovacs Goat A2000 robot lawnmower
excerpt: There's still enough summer left to make this deal worth it.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $600: As of Sept. 7, the Ecovacs Goat A2000 robot lawnmower is down to its lowest-ever price of $1,399 at Amazon, saving you $600.99 from the regular list price of $1,999.99.

Credit: Ecovacs

$1,399 at Amazon
$1,999.99 Save $600.99

OK, so Labor Day — including Amazon's Labor Day sale — might be the unofficial end of the summer, but the weather is still good enough to look for bargains for the garden. And those deals include the Ecovacs Goat A2000 robot lawnmower, which has been marked down over Labor Day weekend.

Of course, there's no shortage of tech on offer at Amazon right now. And this robot lawnmower is exactly the kind of tech we like to see marked down for Labor Day and other major sale events — it's one of those luxury devices that's just too expensive to justify buying throughout most of the year.

As of Sept. 7, the Ecovacs Goat A2000 robot lawnmower has been cut to $1,399, a massive 30 percent savings of $600.99 off the regular list price of $1,999.99. That's the best-ever price at Amazon.

It's not just a great deal for keeping your garden in great shape. It's also a great deal, and allows you to relax at the same time. It uses a HoloScope 360° Dual-LiDAR navigation system that maps your garden and navigates the lawn without a perimeter. It's all hands-free, with obstacle avoidance to prevent bumps and crashes. It also boasts a TruEdge cutter that cuts edge-to-edge neatly.

You can control it via the app, where you can set schedules and no-go zones, and adjust the height and speed. And fast charging ensures that it's always ready for action.
